title: Bundle Expansion
description: This mod expands on the existing bundles within the vanilla game.
body:
# Introducing the Bundle Expansion Mod

Tired of old bundles? Well Minecraft has just received the Bundlier Bundles update!

This mod contains:
- 17 new Expanded Bundles which can hold up to 9 slots with each slot able to hold a full stack.
- 1 new Bundle Belt which can hold up to 9 Expanded Bundles.
- 5 new enchantments with varying levels and abilities.

## Expanded Bundles
![This image shows the 17 different colours of Expand Bundle in a row](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9aed4bae30e3f26658e7d5f01a3e4e69d74c868.png)

## Bundle Belt
![This image shows the Bundle Belt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b749e48fdc12d65b884288853e9c837832158523.png)

## Enchantments
![This image shows the 9 different new enchanted books in a row](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/500617972bc4323ab2df12625be0f93a1447862d.png)

### Smelting

- Level 1 - Smelts ores every 8 seconds, which is 2x slower than a furnace.
- Level 2 - Smelts ores every 4 seconds, which is the same speed as a furnace.
- Level 3 - Smelts ores every 2 seconds, which is 2x faster than a furnace.

### Cooking

- Level 1 - Cooks food every 8 seconds, which is 2x slower than a furnace.
- Level 2 - Cooks food every 4 seconds, which is the same speed as a furnace.
- Level 3 - Cooks food every 2 seconds, which is 2x faster than a furnace.

### Magnetise

- Level 1 - Pulls in items at a 6 block radius.
- Level 2 - Pulls in items at a 10 block radius.
- Level 3 - Pulls in items at a 16 block radius.

### Void

- Level 1 - Destroys the content of a bundle.

### Feeding

- Level 1 - Feeds the player when hungry, if the Expanded Bundle has food.

## How To Use

### Bundle Belt

Press 'B' (this is the default key but can be changed in control settings) or right click whilst holding to open the GUI. Right click an Expanded Bundle on the left hand side to see and interact with it's contents.

![This image shows the Bundle Belt GUI which has an Expanded Bundle highlighted in one vertical row with it's contents in another vertical row to the left hand side](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79bff28dcecb26026ab1adc95efbe76e3c97b34d.png)

### Expanded Bundle

Right click whilst holding to open the GUI.
